name: quality-engineering-platform
description: TypeScript quality engineering platform with Jira workflow orchestration, requirement analysis, automation, impact analysis, reporting, and CI integration.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace platform-core && npm run build --workspace playwright-framework && npm run build --workspace api-framework
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace platform-core && npm run lint --workspace playwright-framework && npm run lint --workspace api-framework
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:api && npm run test:playwright

@platform/core.reason: Internal workspace module used only while loading the Playwright test configuration to validate generation config and resolve report paths.

@playwright/test.reason: Runs the repository's browser automation tests and supplies Playwright fixtures, Page types, assertions, and HTML reporting.

zod.reason: Defines and executes runtime API response schema validation.

typescript.reason: The build and lint scripts in these manifests invoke tsc to compile and type-check the TypeScript workspaces.

@types/node.reason: Provides compile-time declarations for the imported Node.js filesystem, path, URL, OS, and test-runner APIs; it is not a runtime package.

yaml.reason: Parses GitHub Actions YAML for the repository's workflow validation command.
